stories.title: The Day the Sun Went Silent
stories.description: When the Sun nearly shut down and Earth felt the consequences.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up view of the Sun’s surface with very few solar flares. Dark sunspots drift slowly across the glowing surface. Slow camera push-in, realistic space lighting, cinematic contrast, 16:9.
scenes.narration: Did you know there was a moment in history when the Sun itself became unusually quiet and inactive?

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide view of Earth from space under thick cloud cover. The planet rotates slowly as weak sunlight reaches the surface. Cool blue tones, gentle motion, realistic style, 16:9.
scenes.narration: During a rare solar minimum, Earth received less energy, causing global temperatures to fall noticeably.

scenes.visual_prompt: Snow-covered farmland stretching into the distance. Wind moves across frozen fields and dead crops. Slow side tracking shot, overcast lighting, realistic winter atmosphere, 16:9.
scenes.narration: Long, brutal winters followed, destroying crops and triggering widespread hunger across many regions of the world.

scenes.visual_prompt: The Sun slowly growing brighter with gentle solar activity returning. Camera pulls back to reveal Earth warming again. Soft golden light, hopeful tone, cinematic realism, 16:9.
scenes.narration: When solar activity finally returned, climates stabilized, reminding humanity how dependent life is on the Sun.

stories.title: The City That Sank Overnight
stories.description: A real city that vanished beneath the sea in a single night.

scenes.visual_prompt: Ancient coastal city at dusk. Stone buildings glow softly as calm waves touch the shoreline. Slow cinematic pan, warm lighting, realistic environment, 16:9.
scenes.narration: Did you know an entire ancient city disappeared beneath the sea in just one terrifying night?

scenes.visual_prompt: Underwater view of the seabed shaking as cracks form. Buildings tilt slightly as sand rises into the water. Gentle camera shake, dark blue tones, 16:9.
scenes.narration: A sudden earthquake caused the ground below the city to collapse without warning.

scenes.visual_prompt: Submerged ruins resting underwater. Columns and statues lie covered in drifting sand. Slow forward movement, muted colors, quiet atmosphere, 16:9.
scenes.narration: By sunrise, streets, temples, and homes were already resting silently beneath the water.

scenes.visual_prompt: Calm ocean surface at sunrise. Gentle waves reflect soft orange light. Slow pull-back shot, peaceful mood, cinematic realism, 16:9.
scenes.narration: The sea erased the city completely, leaving behind only ruins and legends.

stories.title: The River That Boils Without Fire
stories.description: A real river so hot it can kill without flames.

scenes.visual_prompt: Aerial view of a winding river deep in the rainforest. Steam rises gently from the water surface. Slow drone-style movement, humid atmosphere, realistic jungle lighting, 16:9.
scenes.narration: Deep in the rainforest, there is a river so hot that it appears to be boiling.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of bubbling river water releasing thick steam. Leaves touch the surface and quickly wilt. Static camera, heat shimmer, natural lighting, 16:9.
scenes.narration: Heat from deep underground raises the water temperature high enough to kill instantly.

scenes.visual_prompt: Slow tracking shot along the steaming riverbank surrounded by dense jungle. Heavy mist hangs in the air. Calm but dangerous atmosphere, 16:9.
scenes.narration: Animals sense the danger and avoid the river long before reaching its edge.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide sunset shot of the steaming river glowing orange beneath the forest canopy. Camera slowly pulls back into the jungle. Cinematic mystery, 16:9.
scenes.narration: It is one of Earth’s deadliest natural wonders, hidden quietly within the jungle.
